name: pilot1
about: Live mini-pilot of the engine on the describing-reality pack (2026-10-31): every step for real (GPT-6 Luna through Codex for the episodes, Claude Opus as the designer), at a small size to show the engine works end to end. Too small to be a result: 8 systems in the exam, 4 in each round set and 4 sealed. Item bases are fresh (plans/pilot_items.json). Approval is automatic so the pilot runs unattended; the designer's versions are frozen and kept in work/pilot1/stages.
